tools.name: search_homes
tools.description: Search currently available houses with land. Logged-out. Uses the same eligible inventory and filters as /for-sale/.

tools.name: get_home
tools.description: Full public detail for one home: price, land, source, evidence, save link. Logged-out. Only rights-cleared published homes resolve.

tools.name: home_buyer_questions
tools.description: The 20 rural buyer due-diligence questions for one home, with only source-checked answers filled in. Missing coverage is reported as unassessed, never asserted.

tools.name: board_list
tools.description: List the caller's private saved-homes board. Requires Bearer token.

tools.name: board_save
tools.description: Save an available home to the caller's board. Requires Bearer token.

tools.name: board_update
tools.description: Change a saved catalogue home's stage and/or private notes without clearing omitted fields.

tools.name: board_remove
tools.description: Remove a saved catalogue home from your private board.

tools.name: profile_get
tools.description: Get your private house-hunting criteria. Returns unconfigured until profile_update is called.

tools.name: profile_update
tools.description: Set your personal search profile: supported UK area, maximum budget, number of cats, and optional priorities.

tools.name: search_for_me
tools.description: Search eligible properties using my saved region and budget. Shared website filters; no unverified cat-suitability scores.

tools.name: save_home_url
tools.description: Save a private external listing link, without scraping or publishing. Title, price and location are supplied but unverified.

tools.name: external_update
tools.description: Update stage and/or private notes for an externally saved listing.

tools.name: external_remove
tools.description: Remove one of your private external listing bookmarks.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "board_list" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "board_update" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Move a saved home between stages or edit private notes. Requires Bearer token. Stages: saved, researching, viewing, shortlist, offer, passed." → after: "Change a saved catalogue home's stage and/or private notes without clearing omitted fields."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
